items.title: 구찌 가방 95만원 내렸다...콧대 높던 명품업계에 무슨 일이
items.summary: Reports Gucci cut its Mercato Small Tote price in Korea from 4.45 million won to 3.5 million won (-21.3%), part of a broader first-in-a-decade round of luxury price cuts (Boucheron -11%, Van Cleef & Arpels -4%). Kering CEO Luca de Meo and Burberry CEO Joshua Schulman are quoted acknowledging prior pricing hurt volumes and fatigued consumers.

items.title: "사자마자 130만원 떨어�었어요"...명품값 인하에 기존 구매자들 '허탈'
items.summary: Covers consumer backlash to recent luxury price cuts: Gucci's Padlock Crystal Small Top Handle Bag fell 30% in France (3,500EUR to 2,450EUR) and the Mercato Small Tote fell 21.3% domestically. Quotes an online luxury-community poster lamenting they would have waited had they known, and questioning refund policy. Notes Gucci has posted 13 consecutive quarters of declining sales.

items.title: 불황 속 구찌는 가방값 30% 내렸는데...루이비통은 망설이는 '명품의 금기'
items.summary: Contrasts Gucci's decisive 30% price cuts with Louis Vuitton's hesitation to follow suit, framing price reduction as a historic taboo-break for the luxury sector amid a prolonged downturn and weakened middle-class demand.

items.title: 구찌는 가격 인하, 루이비통은 고수...명품업계의 딜레마
items.summary: Business-angle piece on the divergent pricing strategies between Gucci (cutting) and Louis Vuitton (holding), framing it as a sector-wide dilemma born of contracting luxury demand (~-2% globally) and margin pressure.

items.title: 박보검 구찌 앰버서더 선정...뎀나 체제 구찌의 글로벌 얼굴로
items.summary: Reports actor Park Bo-gum's appointment as Gucci's new global brand ambassador under creative director Demna, positioning him to front house events and campaigns.

items.title: 박보검·닝닝, LA 사로잡은 독보적 아우라... 제15회 구찌 LACMA 갈라 빛내다
items.summary: Covers Gucci ambassadors Park Bo-gum and aespa's Ningning attending the 15th LACMA Art+Film Gala hosted by Gucci, with Park in an all-black notch-lapel look; frames the event as the start of Park's official ambassador duties.

items.title: グッチが中国進出30周年 上海で2028年クルーズコレクション開催
items.summary: Gucci will stage its 2028 Cruise show in Shanghai on 17 May 2027, marking 30 years since its first China store opened; piece recaps past Shanghai shows (2012 FW, 2021 Aria) and cultural projects (Gucci Cosmos 2023, Gucci Bamboo 2025).

items.title: グッチ、「GucciCore」コレクションのローンチイベントに山田涼介ら豪華セレブリティが集結
items.summary: Covers the GucciCore 2027 Cruise collection launch event at Gucci Aoyama on Nov 16, 2026, attended by Gucci Friend of the House Yamada Ryosuke and a large celebrity guest list, with a live performance by hip-hop artist Kohjiya.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀、关店105家、中国制造，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: Chinese financial-media explainer synthesizing three Gucci storylines: Demna's debut runway show, net 105 store closures through nine months (full-year target 125+), and Gucci's first-ever "Made in China" sneaker (the Drip model, ~$1,000/7,050 yuan) breaking a 105-year Italy-made tradition.

items.title: 如何判断古驰的商品是中国制造还是其他国家制造？
items.summary: Weibo consumer-guide post explaining how to identify whether a Gucci item is China-made versus made elsewhere, reflecting active public curiosity/scrutiny following Gucci's first China-made sneaker launch.

items.title: 古驰2026年为何降价30%又推中国制造？3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: Weibo explainer post analyzing why Gucci both cut prices ~30% and introduced China-made production in 2026, tying both moves to margin pressure and the search for Chinese consumer re-engagement.

items.title: 古驰在奢侈品行业地位跌至第九？3个维度看懂它还能不能买+FAQ
items.summary: Weibo post questioning whether Gucci has slipped to 9th place in luxury brand standing, discussing declining brand value and 12 consecutive quarters of sales decline, framed as consumer buying-advice content.

items.title: [theqoo] Park Bogum's face during Gucci's event
items.summary: Korean community (theqoo) thread reacting to Park Bo-gum's appearance at a Gucci event; comment sentiment overwhelmingly positive, praising his styling and edgier look versus his usual image. Exact like/comment counts not visible via aggregator.

items.title: 구찌 시계 장단점(인증)

items.title: Knetz are obsessed with how handsome Park Bogum looks at the 2026 LACMA Art + Film Gala
items.summary: K-pop fan community aggregator capturing Korean netizen reaction threads praising Park Bo-gum's look at the Gucci-hosted LACMA gala; purely fan-sentiment coverage, no brand-strategy content.

items.title: 콧대 꺾인 명품...중산층 지갑 닫자 '가격 백기'
items.summary: Financial-wire piece framing the sector-wide luxury price cuts (Gucci included) as a "white flag" moment after middle-class consumers stopped buying at inflated prices; cites the growing bifurcation between top-tier wealthy buyers and the squeezed middle class.
